verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rules engine or event-triggered automation inside Synthesia. The closest items are a completion webhook (a developer building block a consumer could use to construct automation elsewhere) and in-video branching scenarios (an adjacent interactive-video feature). Neither counts as rules that automatically trigger actions on events, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
